footprint.notes: Qualcomm publishes no state, country or regional employee breakdown: the FY2024 10-K says ~49,000 workers 'working in over 150 locations in 37 different countries', and the 2024 Corporate Responsibility Report gives only a total (49,336 workers). Item 2 gives facilities only as U.S. 5.3m vs other countries 8.8m square feet (square footage is not a lens unit) and names owned and leased manufacturing in China, Germany and Singapore and R&D centers primarily in the United States, India and China, with new facilities under construction in India. The only country split with a value is long-lived tangible assets (U.S. $1.9bn vs outside the U.S. $3.5bn). Revenue by customer headquarters country is in the records and not repeated. No taxes-by-country report was found.
